prompt: 台北市大安區忠孝東路四段216巷33號的 GPS 座標是多少？

assertions.name: has_latitude
assertions.description: Response contains a latitude value (should be around 25.04xx)

assertions.name: has_longitude
assertions.description: Response contains a longitude value (should be around 121.5xxx)

assertions.name: uses_live_api_data
assertions.description: Response is based on actual Geocoding API call rather than general knowledge
